name: LiveScream
source:
Armed with nothing but your curiosity, streaming equipment, and insatiable need to impress others, you approach a long-abandoned house in your small town. What could possibly go wrong?

Step into the role of an intrepid ghost hunter-slash-live streamer-slash-average high schooler and explore a haunted house with your adoring audience.

[From [url=https://lightningrodgames.itch.io/livescream]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
除了你的好奇心、流媒体设备和给别人留下深刻印象的永不满足的需求之外，你一无所有，来到了小镇上一栋废弃已久的房子。可能会出现什么问题？

扮演勇敢的幽灵猎人、直播主播、普通高中生的角色，与崇拜的观众一起探索鬼屋。

[来自[url=https://lightningrodgames.itch.io/livescream]Itch.io[/url]]
